data.title: Why Bitmine Immersion Technologies Stock Is In Focus After Its Ethereum Buying Spree
data.description: Bitmine Immersion Technologies recently acquired nearly US$20 million of Ethereum, bringing its ETH holdings to 6.06 million tokens, equal to 4.9% of the 122.2 million total supply, alongside US$14.5b in combined crypto, cash and marketable securities. This sizeable Ethereum position, together with Tom Lee’s comments on the market’s resilience after the Binance hack, places Bitmine’s operating focus squarely on digital asset exposure and AI infrastructure demand rather than near term...
